'''''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures''''' is a comic book miniseries in the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia initiative. Published by [[Dark Horse Comics]], the series is written by [[Daniel José Older]] and illustrated by [[Toni Bruno]], with cover art by [[Harvey Tolibao]]. It is a relaunch of the ''High Republic Adventures'' title originally published by [[IDW Publishing|IDW]].
